methods.text_en: Present depth through existing partial spatial relationships while keeping key action visible.
methods.text_zh: 从已有空间的局部关系呈现层次，关键动作仍须可见。

methods.text_en: If sound exists, retain its established on/offscreen relationship without adding sound.
methods.text_zh: 若原稿含声音，保持已知声源与画面内外关系，不补声音。
